name: Party inspiration pool
author: Alexandria
summary: Inspiration goes into one shared pool. Any player can draw a point for advantage, at most once a round.

effect.chat: The party's inspiration pool now holds {points}.
{name} draws on the party's inspiration ({points} left). {note}

rules.text: The GM puts inspiration into **one pool the whole party shares** (up to 10). Any player may **draw a point** to gain advantage on a roll they are about to make. Only one point can be drawn each round.

assistant.gm: Reward good roleplay or teamwork by adding a point to the pool with the add action and a note saying why. Only one point can be drawn per round.
assistant.player: The party shares one inspiration pool. If they want advantage on a roll they are about to make, they can draw a point with the draw action, at most one per round for the whole party. Say how many points are left.
